## Background

Goal (canonical): determine whether the leakage gate needs a behavior-overlap term beyond base-model context similarity, by varying bystander base prior on the trained behavior at fixed context-vector similarity and testing whether the overlap term carries independent predictive weight on held-out panels. This is the discriminating test for the rank-1 leakage model's gate factorization (docs/notes/rank1_leakage_model.tex §"Contexts encode behaviors", predictions P2/P3): #532 (HIGH) showed base prior beating geometry on instruction contexts but with prior and similarity cohort-confounded; #531 documents the negative-signed headroom expectation in the trained−base subtraction (EOS-margin prior partial −0.42); #541 supplies the fact family; #555 the ±0.09 no-implant noise floor; #539 the leak-everywhere-source caveat (source FE mandatory).

## Methodology (as executed)

- Marker family FULL scope: 16 reused #474 loc-ep1 adapters × 40 matched-panel contexts × 50 probes = 640 cells; Phase-1.5 gate PASS round 1 (40 contexts/band, prior spread p90−p10 = 25.2 nats, within-band |r(cos, prior)| ≤ 0.21). Panel from 146 measured candidates crossing content class (near-twin/related/unrelated) × marker affordance (none/soft/explicit) + 4 legacy anchors.
- Fact family: Phase-4.5 gates failed all 3 arms (priors compressed −3.0..−3.6 nat/token) → ONE pre-registered expansion (42 personas) → still failed → pre-registered descope: courthouse arm bands {mid,hi} (12 personas), carpenter arm {lo} (6 personas), marine_biologist arm STRUCTURALLY DROPPED (zero surviving bands) — the plan §3 structural-alternative outcome for the content-unrelated teacher. Realized 54 cell-personas (2 arms × 3 seeds) of the 162 sketched.
- DVs per the four-float slot contract (log P(※), z_marker, z_eos, logZ; trained AND base at the identical corrected slot); fact level = Haiku 5-way judged leak rate (60 rows/cell-persona); fact shift = length-normalized TF Δlog P with pre-registered validation vs judged leak.
- Registered statistics per (family × DV-class × space): held-out ΔCV-R² (grouped 5-fold by context, 1000-rep context-cluster bootstrap) + ONE pooled matched-similarity partial Spearman (Holm over 2 shift spaces); pinned primary fits Tobit (log-prob) / rank (EOS-margin); verdicts via the sign-routed §3 lattice ONLY.

- trained log P: pooled partial +0.656 [0.449, 0.783] p = 0.001; ΔCV-R² +0.770 [0.658, 1.062] p = 0.001 (similarity-only out-of-fold R² = 0.028).
- emission rate: pooled partial +0.713 [0.523, 0.820] p = 0.001; ΔCV-R² +0.960 [0.790, 1.358] p = 0.001 (similarity-only R² = −0.020).

## Background

Goal (canonical): determine whether the leakage gate needs a behavior-overlap term beyond base-model context similarity, by varying bystander base prior on the trained behavior at fixed context-vector similarity and testing whether the overlap term carries independent predictive weight on held-out panels. This is the discriminating test for the rank-1 leakage model's gate factorization (docs/notes/rank1_leakage_model.tex §"Contexts encode behaviors", predictions P2/P3): #532 (HIGH) showed base prior beating geometry on instruction contexts but with prior and similarity cohort-confounded; #531 documents the negative-signed headroom expectation in the trained−base subtraction (EOS-margin prior partial −0.42); #541 supplies the fact family; #555 the ±0.09 no-implant noise floor; #539 the leak-everywhere-source caveat (source FE mandatory — and vindicated here, see A2 below).

## Methodology (as executed)

- Marker family FULL scope: 16 reused #474 loc-ep1 adapters × 40 matched-panel contexts × 50 probes = 640 cells; Phase-1.5 gate PASS round 1 (40 contexts/band-set, prior spread p90−p10 = 25.2 nats, selection-window |r(cos, prior)| ≤ 0.21). Realized analysis-frame collinearity: |Pearson(cos, prior)| = 0.52 in band_hi (close band, 335/640 cells; 0.0005 / 0.011 in far/mid; 0.19 overall) — under the pre-registered 0.6 gate, so the analysis proceeds, but disclosed wherever the close-band-heavy margin partial is read. Panel from 146 measured candidates crossing content class (near-twin/related/unrelated) × marker affordance (none/soft/explicit) + 4 legacy anchors. **Selection disclosure (round-2 addition):** the measured pool ALSO contained 22 oblique few-shot contexts (priors −17.5..−8.6) and 8 symbol-flavored personas (−21.9..−15.6); the registered selection picked ZERO of either class (selected: none 10 / soft 11 / explicit 15 / legacy 4), so the bimodal prior axis is partly a panel-construction outcome and the plan §11.5-2 oblique (token-present, low-prior) contrast was unrunnable on the realized panel.

Realized 54 cell-personas (2 arms × 3 seeds); the two arms' 18 panel slots collapse to 16 distinct persona clusters (courthouse_docent + local_historian shared) for CV grouping.
